prompt:
A line-art multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 3 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 9 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a colouring-book drawing: contours only, in one thin uniform black line on white, most of the panel left white. Draw only the people and the few large shapes of the place (walls, doors, windows, a bed, a car). People are simple storyboard figures: hair is one smooth outline of its shape, like a cap, empty inside, with no strands, curls or waves; a face has one short line each for the eyes, brows, nose and mouth, and no stubble, wrinkles or jaw lines; a fence is its posts and top rail, a tree its outline. No texture, mesh, bricks, leaves or fabric folds; no shading, grey or solid black: dark hair, clothes and cars are outlines left white inside. Thin black panel borders, plain white gutters. Location: JI RAN'S OFFICE, Day, rainy outside, bright soft daylight through the windows with warm interior fill.
Image 1: the character sheet of 林青羽 (21), look S1
Image 2: the character sheet of 许半夏 (24)
Image 3: the character sheet of 纪然 (27), look S2
Image 4: the location JI RAN'S OFFICE, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 5: the location JI RAN'S OFFICE, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 6: the location JI RAN'S OFFICE, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 7: the location JI RAN'S OFFICE, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 8: the location JI RAN'S OFFICE, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 9: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Draw each character so they can be told apart as in their reference image, by the shape of the hairstyle, the build and the outfit in outline only; never copy the photograph's detail. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the layout of the space and the place of its furniture and props, drawn in outline. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: There is one large walnut desk with one black leather executive chair behind it. The floor-to-ceiling windows stand behind the desk. The single office door is on the side wall facing the desk, with open floor between the door and the desk. The black leather sofas sit around the white marble coffee table in the lounge area to one side. Lin Qingyu stands just inside the office door, in the open space facing the desk. He is soaked, his hair dripping and his white T-shirt clinging under the open denim jacket, and he is out of breath. Xu Banxia holds the office door open beside him. Ji Ran stands in front of the walnut desk, facing Lin Qingyu. The axis runs from the office door to the desk, and the camera stays on the lounge-area side of it.
Panel 1: Wide shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the lounge-area side; office door on frame left, walnut desk on frame right. Lin Qingyu stands soaked and panting just inside the office door. Xu Banxia holds the door beside him. Ji Ran stands in front of the walnut desk facing him.
Panel 2: Medium close-up, handheld, eye-level, from the lounge-area side, centered on Lin Qingyu. Lin Qingyu pushes wet hair off his forehead. Water drips from his chin as he catches his breath.
Panel 3: Medium shot, slow push in on Ji Ran, eye-level, from the lounge-area side. Ji Ran stands in front of the walnut desk. Her eyes travel slowly from his face down his clinging wet T-shirt.
Panel 4: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level, on Ji Ran's face. Ji Ran keeps her mouth closed and gives a faint, appraising half-smile. One brow lifts.
Panel 5: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, at the office door from the lounge-area side. Xu Banxia presses her lips together to hold back a laugh and steps out. She pulls the office door shut behind Lin Qingyu.
Panel 6: Wide shot, high angle, slow orbit following Ji Ran on the lounge-area side of the axis. Ji Ran folds her arms and walks a slow half circle around Lin Qingyu, inspecting him from head to toe. He stands stiffly in the open space in front of the desk.
Panel 7: Close-up insert, locked-off camera, eye-level, on Lin Qingyu's stomach. Ji Ran's index finger pokes Lin Qingyu's abs through the wet white T-shirt four times, and the fabric dents with each poke.
Panel 8: Medium close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level, on Ji Ran from the lounge-area side. Ji Ran stops in front of Lin Qingyu on the desk side, refolds her arms and looks up at his face.
Panel 9: Close-up, slight low angle, handheld, on Lin Qingyu's face. Lin Qingyu swallows hard. Sweat beads on his forehead and his eyes dart away.
Keep the characters, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no photographic rendering.
